metadata.source: G. Jansonas, R. Budriūnas, M. Vengris, A. Varanavičius. Interferometric measurements of nonlinear refractive index in the infrared spectral range. Opt. Express 30, 30507–30524 (2022) (https://doi.org/10.1364/OE.458850); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: Single crystal LiGaS2 (LGS). Polar angle (θ): 45°, azimuthal angle (φ): 0°. Electric field was parallel to the Y dielectric axis. 230 fs and 190 fs at 1.03 μm and 3.2 μm, respectively. Estimated Kerr values were 4.6e-19 and 4.9e-19 at 1.03 μm and 3.2 μm, respectively. Fourier Interferometry.
